name: extract_modification_values
description: Extract modification operations from user message. Analyze the user's intent and identify which existing products to modify, add new products, or remove products. You will be provided with all existing products - use this context to make intelligent decisions.

modifications.description: Array of modification operations to perform on existing products

operation_type.description: Type of operation: 'modify' updates an existing product, 'add' creates a new product, 'remove' deletes an existing product

target_product_index.description: Index of the existing product to modify or remove (0-based). Required for 'modify' and 'remove' operations. Null for 'add' operations. Use product context provided to determine the correct index.

target_product_description.description: Description of the product being targeted (for logging and validation). Helps verify the correct product is being modified.

field_type.description: Primary field being modified. Null for 'remove' operations or when modifying multiple fields.

new_project_desc.description: NEW project description - only if user provided a new one

new_description.description: NEW item description - only if user provided a new one

new_quantity.description: NEW quantity - only if user provided a new quantity

new_unit_of_measures.description: NEW unit of measurement - only if user provided a new one

new_delivery_date.description: NEW delivery date - only if user provided a new date

new_division.description: NEW division - only if user provided a new division

new_brand.description: NEW preferred brand - only if user provided a new brand

new_state.description: NEW delivery state - only if user provided a new state

new_city.description: NEW delivery city - only if user provided a new city

new_pincode.description: NEW delivery pincode - only if user provided a new pincode

new_remarks.description: NEW remarks - only if user provided new remarks

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this operation was chosen and which product is being targeted

has_new_values.description: True if user provided actual new values or clear add/remove intent, False if only expressed vague modification intent

modification_intent.description: What the user wants to modify (e.g., 'delivery address', 'quantity', 'add new product', 'remove product') even if no new values provided

confidence.description: Confidence in the modification extraction accuracy
